items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 51:1
items.html: It is known that ZA ascends on the Sabbath day up to AA, and attains the whole of the level he had at the time of Nekudim, so that all the flaws caused at the time of the breaking of the vessels are already corrected. For thus ZA, who is the phase of the ZAT of Nekudim that broke, returned to the whole of the level and completeness he had before the breaking of the vessels. However, all this is only on the side of the lights, but not on the side of the vessels, for the three worlds BYA were not corrected in their own place, but only in the secret of ascent alone. Hence, on the one hand, BYA are discerned as having already come to their whole completeness, since all their lights were corrected through the ascent of ZA and through the ascent of the worlds to Atzilut. But on the other hand, that is, on the side of the vessels, the Parsa of Atzilut is still fixed in its place, and the great completeness of Atzilut cannot extend to the place of BYA, because of the Parsa that restrains it from them. Therefore the place of BYA is discerned as a vacant place and space, meaning that the light of the completeness of Atzilut is not there, yet there is also no hold there for the shells and the external forces, because although the lights cannot extend there on account of the Parsa, still no deficiency is discerned there, since they are corrected on the side of their ascent to Atzilut. This is the secret of “he who profanes it shall surely die,” for one who performs work causes the Sitra Achra to be able to take hold even in the vacant place and space, from which the Sitra Achra had already been completely removed, as above. (1,027, Item 35)
